diagnostic_interpretation: The reported overlap, covariate balance, stabilized-weight, and effective-sample-size diagnostics passed the project criteria. These diagnostics support the observed-data implementation but do not establish the absence of unmeasured confounding.
executive_interpretation: Under the stated identification assumptions, the locked primary analysis supports a positive average treatment effect, with the reported confidence interval remaining above the null. Sensitivity estimates were described as tightly clustered.
heterogeneity_interpretation: Predefined subgroup heterogeneity was retained as descriptive analysis. Individual treatment-effect targeting was rejected following validation failures and should not be used for individual-level decisions.
limitations: Causal interpretation depends on consistency, conditional exchangeability, positivity, no interference, correct temporal ordering, and appropriate model implementation.
Observed diagnostics cannot rule out unmeasured confounding.
Synthetic ground truth was evaluation-only and does not replace identification assumptions.
No raw row-level records were supplied to the interpretation layer.
